name: Comenius University Bratislava
description: Slovakia's oldest and largest university, and the only Slovak institution consistently ranked in the QS World University Rankings top 1,000, with strengths across medicine, law, natural sciences and humanities.

name: Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava
description: The largest and oldest university of technology in Slovakia, with faculties covering civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering as well as informatics.

name: Slovak Medical University in Bratislava
description: A specialized state university focused on medicine, public health and postgraduate medical education, established in 2002.
